items.excerpt: Public CV with education, research collaboration, publications, formal verification projects, selected patents, industry experience, and contact.
items.content: Research 最近更新： 2026 年 7 月 教育与方向 研究与成果 行业经历与联系 公开版 CV Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 本页仅保留公开联系方式；完整版简历可邮件索取。 教育背景 爱丁堡大学数学本科（BSc Mathematics） 康奈尔大学交换学生，2025–2026 Expected graduation: 2027 研究方向 优化理论、形式化验证与数学建模。近期兴趣集中在一阶优化方法的机器检查证明、子模优化的近似保证，以及非凸极小极大问题中的 value-function 视角与二阶追踪问题。 研究经历 优化研究合作 2026–至今 与 Prof. Shoham Sabach（Cornell University）合作。 合作始于本人在康奈尔大学交换期间，并在交换结束后继续，聚焦优化理论、网络定位与二阶分析。 发表成果 Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization Archive of Formal Proofs · 2026 正式发表于 AFP（2026）：对基数约束下的单调子模最大化，形式化 classical greedy algorithm 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy variant。发表后扩展：当前仓库继续发展 StochasticGreedy theorem line，包括 sampling、approximation packaging 与 oracle-cost accounting。 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21054718 。 形式化验证项目 First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL 独立项目（无导师）· 2026 独立设计并完成投影梯度下降与一阶优化方法的 Isabelle/HOL 形式化，包括 projection inequality、projected-gradient mapping、凸收敛、强凸线性收敛与可复用的 telescoping structure。项目已提交至 Archive of Formal Proofs，目前等待审核。 Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization 爱丁堡大学信息学院（School of Informatics, University of Edinburgh）· Dr. Wenda Li · 2025–2026 在 Dr. Wenda Li 指导下，独立完成子模函数与贪心算法近似保证的全部 Isabelle/HOL formal proof development。成果已正式发表于 Archive of Formal Proofs；发表后的仓库继续发展 StochasticGreedy theorem line。 Selected Patents Anti-Segregation Spreading Method and Device 发明专利在审。 开发了一种用于改善工业铺料过程中物料均匀性的机械框架。 Anti-Segregation Spreading Device 实用新型 · 2025 年 7 月 4 日授权。 涵盖一种用于工业物料分布的实体装置。 公开页面不展示专利号。 行业经历 数据工程实习生 Liblib AI（Beijing Qidian Xingyu Technology Co., Ltd.） 2025 年 6 月–7 月 通过阿里云数据平台编写 SQL 查询，为运营团队的内部业务需求检索、筛选和转换数据；协助跨多个数据源完成数据提取、聚合与验证，为运营分析提供支持。 Selected Evidence AFP entry · DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21054718 · Proof document · Isabelle/HOL formalization repo · PGD formalization note · TTGDA exploratory note 联系方式 Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) Email: moc.duolci@035reief Available by email Public CV Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) This page lists public contact information only; a fuller CV is available on request by email. Education BSc Mathematics, University of Edinburgh Exchange student at Cornell University, 2025–2026 Expected graduation: 2027 Research Directions Optimization theory, formal verification, and mathematical modeling. Recent interests center on machine-checked proofs for first-order optimization methods, approximation guarantees for submodular optimization, and the value-function viewpoint and second-order tracking questions in nonconvex minimax problems. Research Experience Research Collaboration in Optimization 2026–Present Collaborating with Prof. Shoham Sabach (Cornell University). The collaboration began during my exchange study at Cornell University and continues after the completion of the exchange, focusing on optimization theory, network localization, and second-order analysis. Publications Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization Archive of Formal Proofs · 2026 Published in AFP (2026): a formalization of the classical greedy algorithm and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. Post-publication extension: the current repository additionally develops a stochastic-greedy line, including sampling, approximation packaging, and oracle-cost accounting. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21054718 . Formal Verification Projects First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Independent project (no supervisor) · 2026 Independently designed and completed the Isabelle/HOL formalization of projected gradient descent and first-order optimization methods, including the projection inequality, projected-gradient mapping, convex convergence, strongly convex linear convergence, and reusable telescoping structures. The project has been submitted to the Archive of Formal Proofs and is awaiting review. Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization School of Informatics, University of Edinburgh · Dr. Wenda Li · 2025–2026 Independently completed the full Isabelle/HOL formal proof development of approximation guarantees for submodular greedy algorithms under the supervision of Dr. Wenda Li. The work was published in the Archive of Formal Proofs; the repository subsequently developed a post-publication StochasticGreedy theorem line. Selected Patents Anti-Segregation Spreading Method and Device Invention patent under review. Developed a mechanical framework for improving material homogeneity in industrial spreading processes. Anti-Segregation Spreading Device Utility model · granted 4 July 2025. Utility model covering a physical device for industrial material distribution. Patent numbers are omitted on this public page. Industry Experience Data Engineering Intern Liblib AI (Beijing Qidian Xingyu Technology Co., Ltd.) Jun 2025 – Jul 2025 Supported the operations team by writing SQL queries on Alibaba Cloud's data platform to retrieve, filter, and transform datasets for internal business requests. Assisted in data extraction, aggregation, and validation across multiple data sources for operational analysis.
